v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

text.la: Candor est * lucis ætérnæ, et spéculum sine mácula.
text.en: She is the brightness * of eternal light, and the unspotted mirror.

text.la: Múlier * amícta sole, et luna sub pédibus eius, et in cápite eius coróna stellárum duódecim.
text.en: A woman * clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars.

text.la: Tu glória Ierúsalem, * tu lætítia Israël, tu honorificéntia pópuli nostri.
text.en: Thou art the glory of Jerusalem, * thou art the joy of Israel, thou art the honour of our people.

text.la: Benedícta es tu, * Virgo María, a Dómino Deo excélso præ ómnibus muliéribus super terram.
text.en: Blessed art thou, * O Virgin Mary, by the Lord, the most high God, above all women upon the earth.

text.la: Hódie nomen tuum * ita magnificávit Dóminus, ut non recédat laus tua de ore hóminum.
text.en: This day the Lord * hath so magnified thy name that thy praise shall not depart out of the mouth of men.

text.la: Surge, amíca mea, speciósa mea, et veni, colúmba mea, in foramínibus petræ, in cavérna macériæ, osténde mihi fáciem tuam, sonet vox tua in áuribus meis.
text.en: Arise, my love, my beautiful one, and come: My dove in the clefts of the rock, in the hollow places of the wall, show me thy face, let thy voice sound in my ears.

v.la: Dignáre me laudáre te, Virgo sacráta.
v.en: Holy Virgin, my praise by thee accepted be.

r.la: Da mihi virtútem contra hostes tuos.
r.en: Give me strength against thine enemies.

text.la: Hódie gloriósa cæli Regína * in terris appáruit; hódie pópulo suo verba salútis et pígnora pacis áttulit; hódie Angelórum et fidélium chori immaculátam Conceptiónem celebrántes gáudio exsúltant. Allelúia.
text.en: Today the glorious Queen of heaven * appeared on earth; today her word brought to her people a pledge of peace and salvation; today the choirs of Angels and the faithful exult, celebrating with joy the Immaculate Conception. Alleluia.

text.la: Deus, qui per immaculátam Vírginis Conceptiónem dignum Fílio tuo habitáculum præparásti: súpplices a te quǽsumus; ut, eiúsdem Vírginis Apparitiónem celebrántes, salútem mentis et córporis consequámur.
text.en: O God, who by the Immaculate Conception of the Virgin didst prepare a worthy dwelling place for thy Son, we humbly beseech thee; that we, who celebrate the appearance of the same Virgin, may obtain health of soul and body.

office.title: In Apparitione Beatæ Mariæ Virginis Immaculatæ
